decision: Keep as the current statically validated bare-model candidate. It removes only the supplemental curve brake on compound detector-miss latch frames1--4 while retaining the current-visible-obstacle action, target30, obstacle-side steering and inherited base speed brake. Do not claim a lap-time, clearance, completion, submission or SOTA improvement until an authorized paired driving evaluation passes the safety-first gate.

video_evidence.attribution: user-attributed submission12 replay videos without source/model/package/action receipt binding

obstacle_speed_proxy.method: HSV vehicle/obstacle masks plus Lucas-Kanade background flow and RANSAC camera-motion correction
obstacle_speed_proxy.interpretation: The user's residual obstacle-local slowdown feedback is supported, but the proxy cannot identify internal detector miss-latch phases.

video_evidence.safety_interpretation: Tight rendered gaps reject a global target increase, base-brake reduction or current-visible-obstacle brake reduction.

implementation: Route only bare state-dict inference through _CompoundObstacleLatchReleaseController; explicit export, DrQ and HAIC paths remain unchanged.
Qualify only when pace-latched and command targets are both30, the frame began with a nonzero obstacle-side latch, that side remains active and the detector miss count is1--4.
Return the inherited base brake instead of the supplemental compound curve-brake maximum on those miss frames only.
At target30, candidate brake is0 for30.5<speed<=31,0.04 at32,0.072 at36 and0.12 at40; speed45/48 and base saturation remain control-exact at0.18/0.216/near0.28.
Keep current-visible-obstacle actions, target30, detector, obstacle-side and four-frame latch, steering, gas, fifth-frame clear, reacquisition, clear-straight throttle and noncompound states exact.
Add no mutable candidate state and no seed, track, coordinate, progress or time condition.

static_validation.directed_and_randomized: Current obstacles at speed boundaries, miss1--4, exact target-plus0.5/base onset/base saturation, both directions, sweep below/at6, rows32/50, compound-to-straight latch, fifth clear, sixth release, reacquisition at each miss index, alternating detector flicker, noncompound latch/reacquisition, invalid input, road loss and reset passed. Randomized sequences prove every difference is brake-only and equals the emitted base envelope.

static_validation.independent_audit: Two read-only implementation/video audits found no blocking defect after directed miss-boundary, straight-latch, current-distance, reacquisition and detector-flicker coverage was added.

isolated_package.result: exact-file build/import/reset/action smoke passed; this is not an official Linux, driving or submission evaluation

residual_risks: Rendered video cannot expose the internal84x84 observation, detector result, miss-latch phase, estimated speed or emitted actions, so the proposed cause remains a code-grounded hypothesis rather than video-proven causality.
A detector miss can be a transient flicker while the obstacle is still ahead; retaining target30, steering and base brake bounds the change but does not prove clearance safety.
For30.5<speed<=31 on an eligible miss frame the candidate coasts with gas0/brake0 where control emitted the0.04 supplemental minimum.
Same-input static tests cannot establish future closed-loop completion, collision/off-track non-regression, clearance or lap-time improvement.
SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md and report.pdf remain absent, so environment evaluation, promotion and submission remain blocked.
